advanced.description: Options for advanced users. You should not typically need to modify these.

feature_flags.description: This property is intended for Estuary internal use. You should only modify this field as directed by Estuary support.
feature_flags.title: Feature Flags

field_name_case.description: Casing applied to the names of columns created by this materialization. 'preserve' (the default) names them exactly as the fields are named in the collection; 'lowercase' folds them to lower case which is necessary for some systems such as querying S3 Table Buckets with Athena; 'uppercase' folds them to upper case which is needed for catalogs where unquoted identifiers resolve upper-case such as Snowflake's. Columns that already exist are matched case-insensitively and are never renamed.
field_name_case.title: Field Name Case

table_identifier_case.description: Casing applied to the namespace and table name (together the Iceberg table identifier) of tables created by this materialization. 'lowercase' (the default) folds them to lower case so a binding for MyTable creates the table mytable; 'uppercase' folds them to upper case which is needed for catalogs where unquoted identifiers resolve upper-case such as Snowflake's; 'preserve' uses them exactly as written in the binding. Tables that already exist are never renamed.
table_identifier_case.title: Table Identifier Case

advanced.title: Advanced Options

base_location.description: Base location for the catalog tables. Required if using AWS Glue as a catalog. Example: 's3://your_bucket/your_prefix/'
base_location.title: Base Location

application_id.description: ID of the EMR serverless application.
application_id.title: Application ID

bucket.description: Bucket to store staged data files.
bucket.title: Bucket

bucket_path.description: Optional prefix that will be used to store staged data files.
bucket_path.title: Bucket Path

aws_access_key_id.description: Access Key ID for writing data to the bucket.
aws_access_key_id.title: AWS Access Key ID

aws_secret_access_key.description: Secret Access Key for writing data to the bucket.
aws_secret_access_key.title: AWS Secret Access key

execution_role_arn.description: ARN of the EMR serverless execution role used to run jobs.
execution_role_arn.title: Execution Role ARN

region.description: Region of the EMR application and staging bucket.
region.title: Region

systems_manager_prefix.description: Prefix for parameters in Systems Manager as an absolute directory path (must start and end with /). This is required when using Client Credentials for catalog authentication.
systems_manager_prefix.title: System Manager Prefix

credential.description: Credential for connecting to the REST catalog. Must be in the format of '<client_id>:<client_secret>' for OAuth client credentials. For Bearer authentication use '<token>'.
credential.title: Catalog Credential

oauth2_server_uri.description: OAuth 2.0 server URI for requesting access tokens when using OAuth client credentials. Either a path relative to the catalog URL (usually 'v1/oauth/tokens') or a full URL if the token endpoint is on a different host (for example 'https://login.dremio.cloud/oauth/token' for Dremio Cloud).
oauth2_server_uri.title: OAuth 2.0 Server URI

scope.description: Authorization scope for connecting to the catalog when using OAuth client credentials. Example: 'PRINCIPAL_ROLE:your_principal'
scope.title: Scope

aws_role_arn.description: AWS Role which has access to the resource which will be assumed by Flow
aws_role_arn.title: AWS Role ARN

dbt_job_trigger.description: Trigger a dbt Job when new data is available

access_url.description: dbt access URL can be found in your Account Settings. See go.estuary.dev/dbt-cloud-trigger
access_url.title: Access URL

cause.description: You can set a custom 'cause' message for the job trigger. Defaults to 'Estuary'.
cause.title: Cause Message

interval.description: Minimum time between dbt job triggers. This interval is only triggered if data has been materialized by your task.
interval.title: Minimum Run Interval

mode.description: Specifies how should already-running jobs be treated. Defaults to 'skip' which skips the trigger if a job is already running; 'replace' cancels the running job and runs a new one; while 'ignore' triggers a new job regardless of existing jobs.
mode.title: Job Trigger Mode

dbt_job_trigger.title: dbt Cloud Job Trigger

glue_optimizers.description: Configure AWS Glue managed table optimizers for compaction

enable_compaction.description: Enable automatic compaction of small Iceberg data files to improve query performance.
enable_compaction.title: Enable Compaction

enable_orphan_file_deletion.description: Enable automatic deletion of files that are no longer referenced by any table snapshot.
enable_orphan_file_deletion.title: Enable Orphan File Deletion

enable_retention.description: Enable automatic removal of old Iceberg table snapshots to reduce storage costs.
enable_retention.title: Enable Snapshot Retention

execution_role_arn.description: IAM role ARN that Glue assumes to perform table optimization. The role must have permissions to read/write table data in S3 and access the Glue catalog.
execution_role_arn.title: Execution Role ARN

number_of_snapshots_to_retain.description: Minimum number of Iceberg snapshots to retain regardless of the retention period. Uses the Glue default of 1 if unset.
number_of_snapshots_to_retain.title: Number of Snapshots to Retain

orphan_file_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain orphan files before deletion. Uses the Glue default of 3 if unset.
orphan_file_retention_days.title: Orphan File Retention Days

snapshot_retention_days.description: Number of days to retain Iceberg snapshots. Uses the Glue default of 5 if unset.
snapshot_retention_days.title: Snapshot Retention Days

glue_optimizers.title: Glue Table Optimizers

hard_delete.description: If this option is enabled items deleted in the source will also be deleted from the destination. It is disabled by default and _meta/op in the destination will signify whether rows have been deleted (soft-delete).
hard_delete.title: Hard Delete

namespace.description: Namespace for bound collection tables (unless overridden within the binding resource configuration).
namespace.title: Namespace

syncSchedule.description: Configure schedule of transactions for the materialization.

fastSyncEnabledDays.description: Days of the week that the configured Sync Frequency is active. On days that are not enabled, transactions will be executed more slowly for the entire day. Examples: 'M-F' (Monday through Friday, inclusive), 'M,W,F' (Monday, Wednesday, and Friday), 'Su-T,Th-S' (Sunday through Tuesday, inclusive; Thursday through Saturday, inclusive). All days are enabled if unset.
fastSyncEnabledDays.title: Fast Sync Enabled Days

fastSyncStartTime.description: Time of day that transactions begin executing at the configured Sync Frequency. Prior to this time transactions will be executed more slowly. Must be in the form of '09:00'.
fastSyncStartTime.title: Fast Sync Start Time

fastSyncStopTime.description: Time of day that transactions stop executing at the configured Sync Frequency. After this time transactions will be executed more slowly. Must be in the form of '17:00'.
fastSyncStopTime.title: Fast Sync Stop Time

syncFrequency.description: Frequency at which transactions are executed when the materialization is fully caught up and streaming changes. May be enabled only for certain time periods and days of the week if configured below; otherwise it is effective 24/7. Defaults to 30 minutes if unset.
syncFrequency.title: Sync Frequency

timezone.description: Timezone applicable to sync time windows and active days. Must be a valid IANA time zone name or +HH:MM offset.
timezone.title: Timezone

syncSchedule.title: Sync Schedule

url.description: Base URL for the catalog. If you are using AWS Glue as a catalog this should look like 'https://glue.<region>.amazonaws.com/iceberg'. Otherwise it may look like 'https://yourserver.com/api/catalog'.
url.title: URL

warehouse.description: Warehouse to connect to. For AWS Glue this is the account ID.
warehouse.title: Warehouse

additional_table_properties.description: Additional Iceberg table properties to set when the table is created. These are set only at creation time and cannot be changed afterwards. Example: {'write.parquet.compression-codec': 'zstd'}
additional_table_properties.title: Additional Table Properties
